OXYGEN SENSORS INSPECTION

1. WARM UP ENGINE
Allow the engine to warm up to normal operating temperature.

2. INSPECT FEEDBACK VOLTAGE
Connect the positive (+) tester probe of a voltmeter to terminal VF1 (for No.1) or VF2 (for No.2) of the DLC 1, and negative (–) tester probe to terminal E1. Do the test as described on the next page.
HINT: Use SST when connecting between terminals TE1 and E1 of the DLC1.
SST 09843–18020
